suggestions: I'm grateful for a deployment that went out on a Friday and didn't blow up over the weekend.
I'm thankful for the first sip of teh tarik after a meeting that ran way too long.
I'm grateful for catching the LRT doors before they closed, bag and all.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm grateful for the stillness of the house right before Fajr, before anyone else is up.
I'm thankful for my sister sending random memes in the family group chat at 2am for no reason.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that actually matched production for once.
I'm thankful for the rain cooling everything down right after I got home instead of while I was still stuck on the road.
I'm grateful for a manager who said "take the day off" and actually meant it.
I'm thankful for finding the one Stack Overflow answer that matched my error message word for word.
I'm grateful for the makcik at the pasar malam throwing in an extra piece of ayam percik without me asking.
I'm thankful for a payslip landing on time this month, no delays, no drama.
I'm grateful for a laptop fan that finally stopped sounding like it's about to take off.
I'm thankful for a sujud that lasted longer than usual because nothing was pulling at my mind.
I'm grateful for a friend who still remembers my order after years of it never changing.
